response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT "observstation", COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM "telescopes" GROUP BY "observstation"), shares AS (SELECT telescope_count, CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.telescope_count) AS average_telescope_count, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - b.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE s.share > b.average_share;
